# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Aug 10, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on preparing for OPSC Rehearsal 1 and significant progress on SDM devnet rollout and validation. Several SDM-related issues were closed, and new issues were opened concerning Lightnode deployment.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

- **OPSC Rehearsal Preparation**: A new rehearsal configuration was added to the repository to facilitate OPSC Rehearsal 1, ensuring CI can run for the upcoming event. ([#1517](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1517))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

- **SDM Devnet Rollout and Validation**: Significant progress was made on the SDM devnet, with the `sdm-net-0` now in a steady state, SDM effective and restart-proof, and fault proofs proposing. The rollout portion of the issue is complete, with remaining work proceeding via sub-issues. ([#21273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21273))
- **SDM Operator Opt-in and Documentation**: Issues related to the SDM operator opt-in mechanism and its documentation were addressed and closed. The operator opt-in is now armed at boot, and documentation has been updated to reflect the correct implementation. ([#22346](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/22346), [#22347](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/22347))
- **Invalid Interop Message Recovery Runbook**: The issue concerning the invalid interop message recovery runbook was closed, with a link to the completed Notion document provided. ([#21161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21161))

## NEW ISSUES

- **Lightnode Deployment Strategy**: Two new issues were opened to plan the re-deployment of Lightnode as the majority configuration in both staging and production environments. This initiative aims to bake and validate light nodes in preparation for interop activation. ([#22352](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/22352), [#22354](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/22354))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

- **SDM: standing workload on sdm-net-0** ([#22343](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/22343)): The implementation for a continuous SDM-exercising workload on `sdm-net-0` is currently under review. The deployment strategy involves an in-cluster standing daemon using netchef's `op-benchmark` chain service to spam a custom StateBloat scenario at 5 TPS. This setup ensures that virtually every block carries same-slot transactions and familiar warm-access refunds. The PRs for this implementation are in draft and will be merged in order. The goal is to confirm continuous rebate-carrying blocks once merged.
